findings.description: Saving a new expense creates it twice: two identical rows appear in the list and the total is inflated by double the amount (e.g. adding $10.10 raised $399.99 to $420.19).
repro: Open /expenses/new, enter title 'UI created', category travel, amount 7.25, Save
Observe two identical rows in /expenses and the total increased by 14.50

findings.description: Expense titles are silently truncated to 20 characters on create and on edit (a 25-char title is saved as 20 chars) with no validation message or maxlength on the input.
repro: Create an expense with a 25-character title
List shows only the first 20 characters

findings.description: Expense titles are rendered into the table without HTML escaping (title 'x' renders as bold 'x'), a stored XSS vector visible to viewers too.
repro: View /expenses: the cell contains raw x markup rather than literal text

findings.description: Invalid submissions (negative amount, blank title, more than 2 decimals such as 1.005) return HTTP 400 and re-render an empty form with no error message and the entered values lost; the user gets no hint what was wrong. Amounts with 3 decimals are rejected rather than rounded, with no feedback.
repro: POST /expenses with amount=-3 (or 1.005) bypassing browser validation
Page shows a blank New expense form with no error text

findings.description: Delete button removes the expense immediately with no confirmation step, and deleting a non-existent expense id returns a redirect as if it succeeded.
repro: Click Delete on a row: row is removed with no confirmation

findings.description: Large amounts and totals are shown without thousands separators (e.g. $1234567.89, Total: $2669577.07), hard to read.

notes: Viewer permissions (403 on new/edit/create/delete) and anonymous redirects worked correctly; category filter totals matched. Session cookie lacks Secure flag (http only, not reported). I left test rows in the data.

cost.notes: estimate from 26932 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0054-$0.0646
